name: inaudible-markup
description: An Agent Skill that makes every reply a structured script whose markup a text-to-speech voice does not read aloud. It lists the characters tested silent in voice mode (square brackets, round brackets, braces, dash, colon, tilde, backticks, guillemets, ordinary punctuation, maths symbols U+2200-U+2213) and the ones that are spoken and should be avoided (=, Greek letters, emoji). It adds the GNOX callout and tag convention ({@person}, #tags, namespace resolution) and labels for what a passage is ({Decision}, {Request}, {Definition}, {Open question}, {Correction}), so a conversation log can be reviewed and parsed afterwards by a person, another model or a knowledge-capture pipeline.
